note: Real outputs of embed_demo.py. Hotel Hoshi is FICTIONAL. Vectors are normalized to length 1; cosine = dot product; points = round(cosine*100). The 2D map is a squashed PCA view.

settings.pca: sklearn PCA(n_components=2, svd_solver='full', random_state=0), sign fixed so the first word is in the (+,+) quarter
